create_metric_logger: create a MetricLogger instance to manage and track evaluation metrics for gym environments
create_metric: create a new metric with custom single and multi episode aggregators via MetricLogger.create_metric
create_scalar_metric: create a scalar metric using MetricLogger.create_scalar_metric with a single episode aggregator function
get_episode_metrics: get all registered metrics for the current episode by calling MetricLogger.get_episode_metrics
common_stats: compute mean max min and std statistics from a sequence of float values using common_stats
